top_signals.title: The great aluminum squeeze: London supply crunch deepens as warehouse stocks slide
top_signals.summary: Iran war disruption has driven the historic London Metal Exchange's warehoused stock of aluminum to levels not seen in decades — forcing it to act.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Hong Kong Dollar Hits Six-Month High as Funding Costs Climb
top_signals.summary: The Hong Kong dollar extended its rally to a six-month high, propelled by surging local borrowing costs and demand from investors snapping up the city’s equities amid a rally in Chinese stocks.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Kobe city government proposes tax on vacant condo units
top_signals.summary: If enacted, it would mark the first tax in Japan targeting vacant condominium units specifically.
